gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.sola: A furnace powered by sunlight instead of fuel. It needs clear sky access above the block.

Sunlight ramps from a trickle at sunrise to full strength at noon, then back down toward sunset. Peak cook speed is about 90% of a normal furnace. 

Rain cuts that roughly in half, and thunderstorms cut it further. At night or when blocked from the sky it stops completely.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.panel.info.fish:
Place it waterlogged with water sources on all four sides. Insert a fishing rod to catch fish and junk; Lure and Luck of the Sea apply, and the rod takes durability. 

Fortune vanilla treasure in open water (up to 90% force chance). Treasure Mesh replaces that loot with a custom table.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.need_wa: Needs to be waterlogged with water sources on all four sides
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fishnet.info:
An underwater fish trap. Place it in water so it is waterlogged and every horizontal side touches a water source, then insert a fishing rod.

Periodically rolls vanilla fishing loot into its 9 slots. Without Fortune Mesh that is fish and junk only. Rod enchantments (Lure, Luck of the Sea, Unbreaking) apply, and each catch costs durability. Fortune Mesh unlocks vanilla treasure in open water (the same check as a fishing bobber; a 3×3 pond is not enough) and raises the chance to force it, capped at 90%. Treasure Mesh replaces catches with a custom config loot table and overwrites Fortune Mesh. When a catch is about to finish, a fish swims toward the net as a visual effect.
gui.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.s: This furnace needs an unobstructed view of the sky.
The sun must be in the sky for this furnace to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.solar_furnace.i:
A furnace powered by sunlight instead of fuel.

Needs clear sky access above the block and the sun in the sky. Speed peaks around noon at about 90%% of a normal furnace, and slows near sunrise and sunset. Rain cuts that roughly in half, and thunderstorms cut it further. At night or when blocked from the sky it stops completely.

Smelting XP is stored like a vanilla furnace and awarded when you take the output (or when the block is broken). Accepts Overclock upgrades (max 3) to speed up smelting.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.dev_null.info:
A handheld void filter. Put an item in its slot; once that stack reaches its limit, further pickups of that item are automatically voided.

You can also insert items manually to destroy them. Use the selected slot as a stand-in for that item when interacting with the world.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_dev_nu:
An upgraded handheld void filter with expandable slots, multiple pages, and configurable stack limits.

Put items in filter slots to void matching pickups once each slot is full. Right-click to open the configuration UI for slots, pages, stack size, and cosmetics.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.mini_chest.info: A tiny one-slot chest. Stores a single item stack and works with hoppers and other inventory automation.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.trash_can.info:
A single-slot disposal block. Inserted items are kept up to a normal stack size; anything beyond that is voided. Changing the stored item type voids the previous stack.

Ghost filter slots support blacklist or whitelist mode so automation only voids what you allow.
Emits a redstone pulse on a configurable cycle.

Interval is the full cycle length in ticks; pulse length is how long the signal stays powered within each cycle.

The spinning face is cosmetic and shows whether the clock is allowed to run.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.basic_item_coll:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind the collector.

Uses blacklist filter slots, with configurable pickup range, delay, and batch size.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.advanced_item_c:
Attach to any block face. Vacuums nearby item entities into the inventory behind the collector.

Supports blacklist or whitelist filtering, larger range and batch size, optional line-of-sight collection, redstone control, and a range overlay.
A crafting component used to make machine upgrades. Has no effect on its own.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.productivity_up:
Increase the output of compatible machines.

Each upgrade adds a percentage bonus to produced amount. Shift right-click a machine while holding the upgrade to insert them easily.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.overclock_upgra:
Increase the speed of compatible machines.

Each upgrade shortens process time by a percentage. Past 100% total, extra upgrades keep increasing speed instead of stopping. Shift right-click a machine while holding the upgrade to insert them easily.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.fortune_mesh_up:
Fishnet-only upgrade that unlocks vanilla treasure fishing in open water and raises the chance to force a treasure catch.

Without this upgrade the fishnet only rolls fish and junk. Only works in vanilla open water (the same check as a fishing bobber), and only if rare loot is allowed in the fishnet config. Each Fortune Mesh adds a configurable treasure chance (default 10% per upgrade, up to 9). Maximum force chance is 90% — never guaranteed. Treasure Mesh overwrites this loot while installed. Does nothing in a small pond where treasure cannot drop.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.treasure_mesh_u: Fishnet-only upgrade. While installed, each catch rolls from a custom loot table that overwrites Fortune Mesh and vanilla fishing loot.
Weights are relative: higher weight is more likely, they do not add up to a 0–1 chance.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.stone:
A resource generator. Place matching blocks or fluids on its sides (and optionally below) to match a recipe, then insert results into an inventory above.

Some side resources are kept; others are consumed after a full cycle. Lock Output pins the last successful recipe. Accepts Productivity and Overclock upgrades (except Creative), plus redstone control.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.rando: A special resource generator that places ore blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.metal: A special resource generator that places metal blocks above itself when its recipe conditions are met.
jei.dopasrandomutilities.generator.creat: Creative variant: upgrades cannot be installed.
